name: claude-devohmycode-mods
description: Function-hook mods for Claude Code: a tabbed pane beside the transcript, the messages other sessions send held out of the context until you say otherwise, and the journal of what every model request of a session read, wrote and produced, and the waste a session repeats named on a card you fix in one click.

plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: One pane of tabs beside the transcript, and the $.cockpit noun other plugins fill: the session's context, cost and models, what it spent and what the plan has left, the prompts this machine has typed, the files Claude touched, the tools it called and the subagents it started.

plugins.name: message
plugins.description: What another session sends lands in a tab instead of in the context: session.receive turns the delivery away before it costs a token, the thread lives in a mailbox on disk, and a field answers through SendMessage without starting a model turn.

plugins.name: clauget
plugins.description: The scale, then the diet: one line per model request read off the stop chunk of turn.step, the cache misses named where they happen, and a /clauget report of what each provider of the prefix costs. Measures and changes nothing out of the box; /clauget on turns on levers each measured on a real session — result cuts filed whole, a small-prefix explorer, a lighter compaction, economy tiers — and prints its own cost beside every saving.

plugins.name: contextmanager
plugins.description: Catches what bogs a session down: a ledger of every tool call, a background audit that names the behaviours Claude keeps repeating (the whole suite after each edit, the same file read again, a log dumped into context), and a pane where one click tells Claude to stop, rewords the fix, or ignores it. Reads in English, French, Spanish, German, Chinese and Japanese.

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: Make your own plugins and mods, and catch what a mod breaks without a word: /forge new writes a mod or a classic plugin in this repository's shape, /forge lint reads the source for what the loader refuses or what fails silently, and /forge check adds tsc, validate --strict with its inventory compared to the source, and plugin test.

plugins.name: switch
plugins.description: A pane of the models and the effort levels, each switched with one click: /switch opens it, /switch opus or /switch high switches without it. A click runs the engine's own /model or /effort, so the status line follows.
